source_text: 虚构活动“周末阅读角”：桌边一盏灯、一册书，安静、温暖，不使用真人或商标。

inputs.lower_limbs: Both legs bend and gather to one side of the body, one thigh angling forward while the other leg folds behind, the calves lying close together.
inputs.pose_lead: Grounded pose, mermaid side-sit with rear support:
inputs.torso_head: The chest lifts upward and the waist arches slightly back; the head rises and turns toward the upper side.
inputs.upper_limbs: Both arms reach behind the body, palms pressing the ground, elbows almost straight.
inputs.weight_silhouette: Weight rests mainly on the hips and both hands, the body tracing an S-line from lifted chest through arched waist to legs spreading sideways.

output.example: 合成内容示例（供理解输出方向，未运行模型）：画面候选：以黄铜桌灯和打开的书为主体，保持无品牌；根据「贴地姿势库（25 个参考姿势）」的风格与构图字段调整表现。这里只描述待生成画面，不展示或声称已经出图。

review_checks: 核对所有事实能在输入资料或已接受引用中找到。
核对输出满足 面向坐/跪/卧姿势的四段式 camera-relative 英文姿势句库；单句直接复制进任意图像提示词的 pose 槽
缺失或未确认信息必须明确标注；不得新增授权、执行或生产完成声明。
